annotations.text:
Brambletally — logged-in home screen.
Two containers for the same content: a ruled ledger sheet vs enriched cards.
Both get the tally, the emblems and the hero/rest hierarchy — those are the parts that fix "plain text boxes".

B — LEDGER — not chosen.
Commits to the brand's own metaphor: one parchment sheet, ruled margin, mono column heads, rubrics, red ink for overdue, marginalia in italic Garamond.
Lost on touch targets and density in a 560px column.

A — ENRICHED CARDS — chosen 2026-09-12.
Keeps the card shape already shipping and loads it up: a coloured cover band on the hero, emblem tiles, per-project accent edge, tally, hierarchy.
Spec'd into docs/design.md as Pass 3b-5.

The tally and the emblems drop into either container.
The tally needs no schema change. The emblems need one `cover` column.

A fourth palette, purple-dominant — free, not Supporter-gated.
All 43 pairings clear WCAG AA. Values are in docs/design.md → Values.
The name is still open: Heather was the first pass and is being replaced.
